ideas.name: Nikkei ex-dividend recovery
ideas.claim: The Nikkei 225 shows an average recovery over the five business days after an ex-rights date.
ideas.quote: According to historical data, the average scenario is a recovery of about +0.7% within 5 business days after the ex-rights date.
ideas.mechanism: Dividend-related selling and subsequent reinvestment or dip buying
ideas.claimed_result: Average recovery of about 0.7% within five business days after the ex-rights date, based on eight occurrences from 2024 through June 2026.
